risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative detail on trial sizes, contract revenue, timelines, and regulatory status, but relies heavily on forward-looking and aspirational claims regarding clinical efficacy, regulatory approval, commercialization, and patent protection. COVID-19 effects, access to capital, operational disruptions, and trial delays are expressly described as uncertain and not reasonably estimable. Overall tone is cautiously promotional but reflects material development-stage and financing risks.
